title: Overview: Geothermal Snow-Melting Roadways
description: Roads heated by geothermal energy — melting snow without plows or salt. The built world is humanity's biggest artifact: better construction and manufacturing make it faster, cheaper, and greener. title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Geothermal Snow-Melting Roadways: CLT, BIM, WAAM, ICF, UHPC, R-value, Cure, Tolerance. The built world is humanity's biggest artifact: better construction and manufacturing make it faster, cheaper, and greener.
definition: Glossary for Geothermal Snow-Melting Roadways.
key_points: CLT: Cross-laminated timber — structural wood panels.
BIM: Building information modeling — the digital twin of a project.
WAAM: Wire arc additive manufacturing — welding-based 3D printing.
ICF: Insulated concrete forms — foam blocks filled with concrete.
UHPC: Ultra-high performance concrete — exceptionally strong mix.
R-value: Insulation rating — higher resists heat flow better.
Cure: The chemical hardening of concrete and resins.
Tolerance: Allowed deviation — tighter means more precise.

Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
